name: Bitcoin Mining
description: Large-scale Bitcoin mining facilities leverage El Salvador's geothermal and renewable energy, increasing national electricity demand by 30% with concentrated load in industrial zones.

economics.investment_breakdown: Dedicated mining power plants ($220M), grid reinforcement ($150M), cooling infrastructure ($80M), renewable energy expansion ($70M)
economics.economic_loss_explanation: Bitcoin mining revenue ($950M annually), job creation ($180M), technology sector growth ($220M), avoided grid failure costs ($100M)
economics.roi_explanation: Every $1 invested enables $2.80 in mining revenue, tech sector growth, and economic development over 5 years

ai_analysis.executive_summary: Bitcoin mining expansion creates severe infrastructure stress requiring massive capacity investment while generating substantial economic opportunity. Five regions face critical stress with potential for grid instability. Strategic approach needed: dedicated renewable capacity for mining operations separate from residential grid, ensuring mining revenue funds infrastructure expansion rather than competing with citizen needs.

priority_actions.action: Deploy dedicated geothermal power plant for mining operations
priority_actions.impact: Provides 200MW baseload capacity exclusively for mining, removes load from residential grid

priority_actions.action: Construct Bitcoin City renewable energy hub
priority_actions.impact: Creates isolated mining infrastructure with solar+geothermal, protects national grid

priority_actions.action: Mandate mining operations use 100% renewable energy
priority_actions.impact: Drives renewable investment, positions El Salvador as green Bitcoin leader

regional_breakdown.analysis: Capital faces extreme stress with 273 MWh deficit - largest in nation. Major mining facilities located in industrial zones competing with residential and commercial demand. Near-constant brownouts during peak hours.
regional_breakdown.recommendation: Immediately relocate or curtail mining operations during peak residential hours (6-9 PM). Deploy emergency generation capacity (100MW) within 60 days. Long-term: relocate mining to dedicated facilities outside capital region.

regional_breakdown.analysis: Geothermal resources attract mining operations but local grid inadequate. 61 MWh deficit impacts 340K residents. Opportunity: leverage geothermal for sustainable mining model.
regional_breakdown.recommendation: Expand geothermal capacity by 150MW dedicated to mining. Upgrade local transmission to handle increased generation. Create regulatory framework ensuring residential priority during shortages.

regional_breakdown.analysis: Coastal and western industrial zones host major mining facilities. Combined deficit of 195 MWh affects 1.43M residents. Mining operations using 24/7 baseload not aligned with residential patterns.
regional_breakdown.recommendation: Develop Bitcoin City concept in La Libertad with dedicated infrastructure. Implement dynamic pricing to incentivize mining during off-peak hours. Deploy battery storage to smooth residential demand.
regional_breakdown.timeline: 540 days for Bitcoin City, 120 days for pricing reform

risks: Bitcoin price volatility affects mining profitability and infrastructure ROI
Residential electricity access compromised by mining competition
Political backlash if citizens face outages while miners operate
Environmental concerns over energy consumption despite renewable sources
Regulatory uncertainty - mining bans in other countries create precedent risk
opportunities: Position as world's first 100% renewable Bitcoin mining nation
Mining revenue funds national infrastructure expansion ($950M annually)
Create 3,000+ high-tech jobs in mining operations and maintenance
Attract blockchain companies and crypto startups to El Salvador
Leverage volcano-powered geothermal as unique competitive advantage
Export surplus renewable energy to neighbors when mining demand low
Demonstrate cryptocurrency adoption at national scale - global leadership
Use mining as flexible grid load - curtail during emergencies, ramp up when surplus
